title: TeamFlow Hub
subtitle: Full-Stack Product Collaboration Platform
description: A full-stack product collaboration app with a React/TypeScript frontend and Java Spring Boot backend for managing feature requests, project tasks, user feedback, and release status.
highlights: Designed PostgreSQL tables and REST APIs for users, teams, projects, feature requests, assignments, comments, status history, and audit logs
Created responsive UI pages for request submission, task boards, search/filter views, role-based updates, error states, and accessibility-minded form validation
Added backend validation, frontend error handling, unit tests, API tests, and structured logs to improve reliability, debugging, and observability across the app
